en.text: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

zhSimplified.text: 我是因耶和华忿怒的杖， 遭遇困苦的人。

zhTraditional.text: 我是因耶和華忿怒的杖， 遭遇困苦的人。

en.text: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

zhSimplified.text: 他引导我，使我行在黑暗中， 不行在光明里。

zhTraditional.text: 他引導我，使我行在黑暗中， 不行在光明裏。

en.text: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.

zhSimplified.text: 他真是终日再三反手攻击我。

zhTraditional.text: 他真是終日再三反手攻擊我。

en.text: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.

zhSimplified.text: 他使我的皮肉枯干； 他折断我的骨头。

zhTraditional.text: 他使我的皮肉枯乾； 他折斷我的骨頭。

en.text: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

zhSimplified.text: 他筑垒攻击我， 用苦楚和艰难围困我。

zhTraditional.text: 他築壘攻擊我， 用苦楚和艱難圍困我。

en.text: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

zhSimplified.text: 他使我住在幽暗之处， 像死了许久的人一样。

zhTraditional.text: 他使我住在幽暗之處， 像死了許久的人一樣。

en.text: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

zhSimplified.text: 他用篱笆围住我，使我不能出去； 他使我的铜链沉重。

zhTraditional.text: 他用籬笆圍住我，使我不能出去； 他使我的銅鍊沉重。

en.text: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

zhSimplified.text: 我哀号求救； 他使我的祷告不得上达。

zhTraditional.text: 我哀號求救； 他使我的禱告不得上達。

en.text: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

zhSimplified.text: 他用凿过的石头挡住我的道； 他使我的路弯曲。

zhTraditional.text: 他用鑿過的石頭擋住我的道； 他使我的路彎曲。

en.text: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.

zhSimplified.text: 他向我如熊埋伏， 如狮子在隐密处。

zhTraditional.text: 他向我如熊埋伏， 如獅子在隱密處。

en.text: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.

zhSimplified.text: 他使我转离正路， 将我撕碎，使我凄凉。

zhTraditional.text: 他使我轉離正路， 將我撕碎，使我淒涼。

en.text: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

zhSimplified.text: 他张弓将我当作箭靶子。

zhTraditional.text: 他張弓將我當作箭靶子。

en.text: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

zhSimplified.text: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。

zhTraditional.text: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。

en.text: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.

zhSimplified.text: 我成了众民的笑话； 他们终日以我为歌曲。

zhTraditional.text: 我成了眾民的笑話； 他們終日以我為歌曲。

en.text: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.

zhSimplified.text: 他用苦楚充满我，使我饱用茵 。

zhTraditional.text: 他用苦楚充滿我，使我飽用茵蔯。

en.text: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.

zhSimplified.text: 他又用沙石碜断我的牙， 用灰尘将我蒙蔽。

zhTraditional.text: 他又用沙石磣斷我的牙， 用灰塵將我蒙蔽。

en.text: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我远离平安， 我忘记好处。

zhTraditional.text: 你使我遠離平安， 我忘記好處。

en.text: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 我就说：我的力量衰败； 我在耶和华那里毫无指望！

zhTraditional.text: 我就說：我的力量衰敗； 我在耶和華那裏毫無指望！

en.text: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你记念我 如茵 和苦胆的困苦窘迫。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你記念我 如茵蔯和苦膽的困苦窘迫。

en.text: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

zhSimplified.text: 我心想念这些， 就在里面忧闷。

zhTraditional.text: 我心想念這些， 就在裏面憂悶。

en.text: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

zhSimplified.text: 我想起这事， 心里就有指望。

zhTraditional.text: 我想起這事， 心裏就有指望。

en.text: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

zhSimplified.text: 我们不致消灭， 是出于耶和华诸般的慈爱； 是因他的怜悯不致断绝。

zhTraditional.text: 我們不致消滅， 是出於耶和華諸般的慈愛； 是因他的憐憫不致斷絕。

en.text: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

zhSimplified.text: 每早晨，这都是新的； 你的诚实极其广大！

zhTraditional.text: 每早晨，這都是新的； 你的誠實極其廣大！

en.text: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”

zhSimplified.text: 我心里说：耶和华是我的分， 因此，我要仰望他。

zhTraditional.text: 我心裏說：耶和華是我的分， 因此，我要仰望他。

en.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

zhSimplified.text: 凡等候耶和华，心里寻求他的， 耶和华必施恩给他。

zhTraditional.text: 凡等候耶和華，心裏尋求他的， 耶和華必施恩給他。

en.text: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 人仰望耶和华， 静默等候他的救恩， 这原是好的。

zhTraditional.text: 人仰望耶和華， 靜默等候他的救恩， 這原是好的。

en.text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

zhSimplified.text: 人在幼年负轭， 这原是好的。

zhTraditional.text: 人在幼年負軛， 這原是好的。

en.text: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

zhSimplified.text: 他当独坐无言， 因为这是耶和华加在他身上的。

zhTraditional.text: 他當獨坐無言， 因為這是耶和華加在他身上的。

en.text: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

zhSimplified.text: 他当口贴尘埃， 或者有指望。

zhTraditional.text: 他當口貼塵埃， 或者有指望。

en.text: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

zhSimplified.text: 他当由人打他的腮颊， 要满受凌辱。

zhTraditional.text: 他當由人打他的腮頰， 要滿受凌辱。

en.text: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

zhSimplified.text: 因为主必不永远丢弃人。

zhTraditional.text: 因為主必不永遠丟棄人。

en.text: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

zhSimplified.text: 主虽使人忧愁， 还要照他诸般的慈爱发怜悯。

zhTraditional.text: 主雖使人憂愁， 還要照他諸般的慈愛發憐憫。

en.text: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

zhSimplified.text: 因他并不甘心使人受苦， 使人忧愁。

zhTraditional.text: 因他並不甘心使人受苦， 使人憂愁。

en.text: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

zhSimplified.text: 人将世上被囚的踹在脚下，

zhTraditional.text: 人將世上被囚的踹在腳下，

en.text: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

zhSimplified.text: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，

zhTraditional.text: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，

en.text: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

zhSimplified.text: 或在人的讼事上颠倒是非， 这都是主看不上的。

zhTraditional.text: 或在人的訟事上顛倒是非， 這都是主看不上的。

en.text: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

zhSimplified.text: 除非主命定， 谁能说成就成呢？

zhTraditional.text: 除非主命定， 誰能說成就成呢？

en.text: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

zhSimplified.text: 祸福不都出于至高者的口吗？

zhTraditional.text: 禍福不都出於至高者的口嗎？

en.text: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

zhSimplified.text: 活人因自己的罪受罚， 为何发怨言呢？

zhTraditional.text: 活人因自己的罪受罰， 為何發怨言呢？

en.text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 我们当深深考察自己的行为， 再归向耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 我們當深深考察自己的行為， 再歸向耶和華。

en.text: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

zhSimplified.text: 我们当诚心向天上的 神举手祷告。

zhTraditional.text: 我們當誠心向天上的上帝舉手禱告。

en.text: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.

zhSimplified.text: 我们犯罪背逆， 你并不赦免。

zhTraditional.text: 我們犯罪背逆， 你並不赦免。

en.text: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.

zhSimplified.text: 你自被怒气遮蔽，追赶我们； 你施行杀戮，并不顾惜。

zhTraditional.text: 你自被怒氣遮蔽，追趕我們； 你施行殺戮，並不顧惜。

en.text: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

zhSimplified.text: 你以黑云遮蔽自己， 以致祷告不得透入。

zhTraditional.text: 你以黑雲遮蔽自己， 以致禱告不得透入。

en.text: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

zhSimplified.text: 你使我们在万民中成为污秽和渣滓。

zhTraditional.text: 你使我們在萬民中成為污穢和渣滓。

en.text: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的仇敌都向我们大大张口。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的仇敵都向我們大大張口。

en.text: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

zhSimplified.text: 恐惧和陷坑，残害和毁灭， 都临近我们。

zhTraditional.text: 恐懼和陷坑，殘害和毀滅， 都臨近我們。

en.text: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

zhSimplified.text: 因我众民遭的毁灭， 我就眼泪下流如河。

zhTraditional.text: 因我眾民遭的毀滅， 我就眼淚下流如河。

en.text: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

zhSimplified.text: 我的眼多多流泪， 总不止息，

zhTraditional.text: 我的眼多多流淚， 總不止息，

en.text: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 直等耶和华垂顾， 从天观看。

zhTraditional.text: 直等耶和華垂顧， 從天觀看。

en.text: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

zhSimplified.text: 因我本城的众民， 我的眼，使我的心伤痛。

zhTraditional.text: 因我本城的眾民， 我的眼，使我的心傷痛。

en.text: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

zhSimplified.text: 无故与我为仇的追逼我， 像追雀鸟一样。

zhTraditional.text: 無故與我為仇的追逼我， 像追雀鳥一樣。

en.text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

zhSimplified.text: 他们使我的命在牢狱中断绝， 并将一块石头抛在我身上。

zhTraditional.text: 他們使我的命在牢獄中斷絕， 並將一塊石頭拋在我身上。

en.text: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

zhSimplified.text: 众水流过我头， 我说：我命断绝了！

zhTraditional.text: 眾水流過我頭， 我說：我命斷絕了！

en.text: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊， 我从深牢中求告你的名。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊， 我從深牢中求告你的名。

en.text: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”

zhSimplified.text: 你曾听见我的声音； 我求你解救， 你不要掩耳不听。

zhTraditional.text: 你曾聽見我的聲音； 我求你解救， 你不要掩耳不聽。

en.text: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

zhSimplified.text: 我求告你的日子，你临近我， 说：不要惧怕！

zhTraditional.text: 我求告你的日子，你臨近我， 說：不要懼怕！

en.text: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤； 你救赎了我的命。

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤； 你救贖了我的命。

en.text: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你见了我受的委屈； 求你为我伸冤。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你見了我受的委屈； 求你為我伸冤。

en.text: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.

zhSimplified.text: 他们仇恨我，谋害我， 你都看见了。

zhTraditional.text: 他們仇恨我，謀害我， 你都看見了。

en.text: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你听见他们辱骂我的话， 知道他们向我所设的计，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你聽見他們辱罵我的話， 知道他們向我所設的計，

en.text: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.

zhSimplified.text: 并那些起来攻击我的人口中所说的话， 以及终日向我所设的计谋。

zhTraditional.text: 並那些起來攻擊我的人口中所說的話， 以及終日向我所設的計謀。

en.text: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

zhSimplified.text: 求你观看， 他们坐下，起来，都以我为歌曲。

zhTraditional.text: 求你觀看， 他們坐下，起來，都以我為歌曲。

en.text: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你要按着他们手所做的 向他们施行报应。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你要按着他們手所做的 向他們施行報應。

en.text: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

zhSimplified.text: 你要使他们心里刚硬， 使你的咒诅临到他们。

zhTraditional.text: 你要使他們心裏剛硬， 使你的咒詛臨到他們。

en.text: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 你要发怒追赶他们， 从耶和华的天下除灭他们。

zhTraditional.text: 你要發怒追趕他們， 從耶和華的天下除滅他們。
